about.heroSubtitle: OSCAR Fashion is more than a fashion store. It is a vision of Algerian elegance, a passion for style, and a commitment to excellence.
about.storyParagraph1: OSCAR Fashion was born in 2018 from a simple yet ambitious vision: to make quality fashion accessible to all Algerians. Founded by a team passionate about fashion and commerce, our company started as a small boutique in Algiers.
about.storyParagraph2: Today, we are proud to serve thousands of customers across all of Algeria. Our commitment to quality, customer service, and innovation has allowed us to become a benchmark in the online fashion sector in Algeria.
about.storyParagraph3: Every garment we offer is carefully selected to meet our customers' expectations in terms of style, quality, and price. We believe that everyone deserves to feel good in their clothes.
about.missionDescription: To offer Algerians an exceptional fashion shopping experience, combining quality products, affordable prices, and impeccable customer service. We are committed to making trendy fashion accessible to all.
about.visionDescription: To become the leading online fashion destination in Algeria, recognized for our quality, our innovation, and our commitment to customer satisfaction. We aspire to redefine the shopping experience in Algeria.
about.commitmentDescription: At OSCAR Fashion, we are committed to offering a transparent and secure shopping experience. We guarantee the quality of our products and strive to exceed your expectations with every order.
about.ctaSubtitle: Discover our collection and become part of the OSCAR Fashion community.

returns.heroSubtitle: Your satisfaction is our priority. Discover our simple and transparent return policy.
returns.step1Description: Access your account and go to "My Orders"
returns.step2Description: Choose the item to return and the reason for the return
returns.step3Description: Download and print your return slip
returns.step4Description: Pack the item and drop it off at the pickup point
returns.eligibleItem4: Items returned within 7 days of receipt
returns.nonEligibleItem5: Items without original tags or packaging
returns.sizeExchangeDescription: Would you like to exchange an item for another size? This is possible subject to availability. Simply follow the return procedure and indicate the desired size.
returns.sizeExchangeBenefit1: Free exchange for the first request
returns.sizeExchangeBenefit2: Priority shipping of the new size
returns.itemExchangeDescription: To exchange for a different item, please first make a return. Once the refund is processed, you can place a new order.
returns.refundDelayDescription: Once your return is received and approved by our team, the refund is processed within 7 to 14 business days. You will receive a confirmation email as soon as the refund is processed.
returns.refundMethodDescription: The refund is processed using the same payment method used for the purchase:
returns.refundMethodCib: • CIB/EDAHABIA card: refund to your card
returns.refundMethodBaridimob: • BaridiMob: refund to your BaridiMob account
returns.refundMethodCod: • Cash on delivery: transfer to a CCP or BaridiMob account
returns.returnFeesDescription: Return fees are at your expense (between 300 and 500 DZD depending on your zone). Exception: in the case of a defective product or an error on our part, the return fees are fully covered.
returns.defectiveDescription: If you received a defective item or an item different from your order, contact us immediately. We will cover the return fees and offer you an exchange or a full refund.
returns.ctaSubtitle: Our team is available to assist you with your return process.

shipping.heroSubtitle: Everything you need to know about the delivery of your orders
shipping.featureNationalDescription: We deliver to all 48 provinces of Algeria
shipping.featureTrackingDescription: Track your parcel at every step of the delivery
shipping.featurePackagingDescription: Your items are carefully packaged to ensure their protection
shipping.featureFreeDescription: On purchases of 10,000 DZD or more
shipping.freeShippingDescription: Enjoy free delivery on any order over 10,000 DZD!
shipping.step1Description: Add your items to the cart and confirm your order
shipping.step2Description: Your order is prepared and carefully packaged
shipping.step3Description: You receive an SMS with the tracking number
shipping.step4Description: The courier contacts you before arriving
shipping.noteVerificationDescription: Please check the condition of your parcel in the presence of the courier. In the event of a visible problem, you may refuse the delivery or note your reservations on the delivery slip.
shipping.noteContactDescription: Our courier will contact you by phone before delivery to confirm your availability. Make sure your phone number is correct when placing your order.
shipping.noteAttemptsDescription: If you are absent, 3 delivery attempts will be made. After 3 failures, the parcel will be returned to our warehouse and you will be contacted to reschedule the delivery.
shipping.ctaDescription: Our customer service is available to answer all your questions.

sizeGuide.heroSubtitle: Find the perfect size for every purchase
sizeGuide.tipChestDescription: Measure horizontally at the fullest part of the chest, under the armpits.
sizeGuide.tipWaistDescription: Measure at the narrowest part of the torso, usually at the navel.
sizeGuide.tipHipsDescription: Measure at the widest part of the hips, about 20 cm below the waist.
sizeGuide.tipFootDescription: Place your foot on a sheet of paper and trace the outline. Measure from the heel to the big toe.
sizeGuide.adviceSubtitle: Follow these tips to find the size that suits you best.
sizeGuide.adviceSoftTapeDescription: Do not pull the measuring tape too tight against your body for accurate measurements.
sizeGuide.adviceUnderwearDescription: For accurate measurements, wear as little clothing as possible.
sizeGuide.adviceHelpDescription: Ask someone to help you for more accurate measurements.
sizeGuide.adviceBetweenSizesDescription: If your measurements fall between two sizes, choose the larger size for more comfort.
sizeGuide.adviceReviewsDescription: Customer reviews often mention whether an item runs large or small.
sizeGuide.adviceExchangeDescription: Remember that you can exchange the item if the size does not fit.
sizeGuide.faqStandardAnswer: Our sizes follow European standards. Always check our chart for each item.
sizeGuide.faqFitQuestion: How do I know if an item runs large/small?
sizeGuide.faqFitAnswer: Each product page indicates whether the item fits normally, runs large, or runs small.
sizeGuide.faqExchangeQuestion: Can I exchange if the size doesn't fit?
sizeGuide.faqExchangeAnswer: Yes, size exchanges are free, subject to availability.
sizeGuide.faqFootQuestion: How do I measure my foot correctly?
sizeGuide.faqFootAnswer: Measure your foot at the end of the day when it is slightly swollen, for more accuracy.
sizeGuide.contactSubtitle: Our team is here to advise you and help you find the perfect size.
